name: Animal Taming
stack_gaps: suitable animal population, capture, husbandry, breeding continuity
review_note: Seasonal patterns alone currently support a broad capability that includes staying, breeding, and following.

name: Basketry
review_note: Alternative fiber and vessel-experiment routes remain causal and resource-bound.

name: Bone-Needle Sewing
stack_gaps: ordinary bone supply; early hide or fiber material
review_note: The current operating contract obtains bone only from post-siege hunting and assumes later cloth or yarn, so it cannot carry ordinary opening sewing.

name: Clay Vessels
review_note: Valid early practice with a clay sample; paced exposure should prevent a day-one cluster.

name: Tempered Clay
review_note: Combines vessel shaping with comparative material evidence.

name: Clay Testing
review_note: Material observation precedes reliable vessels and firing.

name: Clean-Water Practice
review_note: Practice can arise from wound experience or counted illness around wells; operation still needs accessible freshwater.

name: Controlled Flaking
review_note: Uses selected stone and an encountered knappable resource.

name: Twisted Cordage
review_note: A broad enabling material practice with a real fiber requirement.

name: Crop Calendars
review_note: Preserves cultivation timing across households after selective planting exists.

name: Ground Drainage
review_note: A plausible root observation that should be exposed by rain and occupied-ground work rather than arbitrary early selection.

name: Edible Resource Recognition
review_note: Makes local food classification operational rather than a generic yield bonus.

name: Fiber Grading
review_note: Supports cordage, carriers, clothing, and later record media.

name: Food Drying
review_note: A valid root practice, but one of many simultaneous opening roots that need paced exposure.

name: Framed Construction
review_note: Knowledge foundations are credible; transformation credit requires an operating durable structure rather than knowledge alone.

name: Graded Roads
stack_gaps: paid surfaced route length, drainage, traffic, recurring repair
review_note: Crowned and drained roads should change movement only where route segments are built and maintained; knowledge currently contributes global route and haul effects.

name: Gravity Conduit Grade Control
review_note: The installed water-conveyance owner already requires surveyed grade, paid line materials, construction work, source flow, leakage, condition and repair.

name: Hafted Tools
review_note: Integrates stone, wood, fiber, and accessible material supply.

name: Hearth Roasting Control
review_note: Operational cooking exists, but the live catalog lacks prior fire maintenance and ignition anchors.

name: Medicinal Classification
review_note: Plausible early practice, but should progress through repeated cases rather than arrive in the opening discovery burst.

name: Household Councils
review_note: Creates recognized coordination once recurring communal labor already exists.

name: Irrigation Schedules
stack_gaps: deliverable water, field allocation, turn compliance, loss and drainage records
review_note: Calendars, drainage and tallies support scheduling, but yield and state effects currently do not depend on finite conveyed water or operating irrigated fields.

name: Wood Joinery
review_note: Two credible early learning routes converge on one timber-working capability.

name: Controlled Kilns
stack_gaps: installed kiln, firing volume, fuel, maintenance
review_note: The causal knowledge stack is sound, but broad craft and fuel effects currently operate without a maintained enclosed kiln or bounded firing service.

name: Labor Rotations
review_note: Makes sustained communal stores and projects possible; should emerge from actual competing work obligations.

name: Latrine Siting
stack_gaps: located waste ground, digging, separation, upkeep
review_note: Siting knowledge currently grants settlement-wide sanitation without a paid, maintained waste facility separated from water and occupied ground.

name: Lime Mortar
stack_gaps: operating mortar batches and installed maintained masonry
review_note: Real slaked lime, sand, water, mortar batches and masonry uses exist, but the discovery still grants broad passive effects before those stocks and structures operate.

name: Managed Fallow
review_note: Represents a land-management consequence after calendars exist.

name: Pit Firing
review_note: Its alternate route treats food drying as sufficient heat knowledge; both routes should require a real controlled-fire foundation.

name: Protected Wellheads
stack_gaps: existing well, built cover and apron, drainage, upkeep
review_note: The discovery correctly protects rather than creates supply, but its safety effect currently precedes a physical wellhead project.

name: Public Stores
review_note: Knowledge foundations are sound, but the transformation requires an actual maintained communal reserve rather than a global effect alone.

name: Rainwater Cisterns
stack_gaps: catchment, lining, finite storage, rainfall, cleaning
review_note: The alternative lining routes are credible; operation still needs a paid cistern whose stored water rises with rain, is finite, and can become contaminated.

name: Encoded Routes
review_note: Preserves spatial knowledge before durable records.

name: Sealed Vessels
review_note: Requires developed clay access and enables durable reserve handling.

name: Protected Seed Reserves
review_note: Connects cultivation continuity to public storage and accessible land.

name: Selective Planting
stack_gaps: sowing, harvest, and retained seed practice
review_note: Seasonal observation and fertile-soil recognition are insufficient by themselves to establish selective planting as an operating system.

name: Shallow-Foundation Assessment
review_note: Paid survey kits and site response records already modify selected building work through the existing construction and maintenance owner.

name: Smoke Preservation
review_note: The food-drying route currently reaches smoke preservation without explicit fire control.

name: Stone Selection
review_note: Requires an encountered stone sample and supports the first tool chain.

name: Material Tallies
review_note: Plausible root information practice whose appearance should follow an experienced counting or storage problem.

name: Timber Grading
review_note: Separates recognition of useful wood from later construction methods.

name: Timber Seasoning
review_note: Requires developed timber access and supports durable construction.

name: Organized Watch
review_note: The practice is plausible but should respond to a real protection problem rather than appear as an unrelated day-one inquiry.

name: Water Settling Basins
stack_gaps: built basin, retained water, draw-off work, cleaning
review_note: Settling has appropriately modest scope, but water-safety credit requires actual batch residence and basin maintenance.

name: Well Siting
review_note: Alternative drainage and landscape-observation routes retain a real freshwater requirement.
